me_span_diagnosis.finding: The v6 proposals often expose one whole supporting span containing both the action and outcome propositions. The v7 verifier re-copied that whole span for both lanes rather than producing mechanically distinct minimal exact subspans. The raw runtime then incorrectly treated equal start positions as proof that outcome was not after action.
me_span_diagnosis.minimal_implementation_fix: When action and outcome select the same exact grounded span, do not assert mechanical ordering from equal span starts. Continue to require exact proposal/source binding and leave semantic ordering/distinctness to the frozen typed ME gate. Distinct-span reverse order remains mechanically rejected.
me_span_diagnosis.important_limit: This fix only removes a false local rejection. It does not repair Qwen's six same_predicate=true/accepted=true contradictions or the five MP semantic misclassifications, and it is not sufficient to authorize 401 execution.

recommendation.reason: The general v7 verifier did not preserve old PASS systematically and accepted five known MP FAIL cases. The local shared-span bug is fixed offline, but most failures are Qwen semantic/decision-consistency failures rather than binding bypasses.
